Ahem, well you see sir in order to open such a bridge even with a Quantum computer you have to solve and theorize on and on every step of the way. So what's a Quantum Leaping, Sliders and Ring Gate running rock hopper to do? Use a Quantum AI. Model the so-called error correction directly on how nature uses it - birds, plants, if you know you know. Quantum Echoes and Scaling solve for entropic collapse. You no longer need to isolate from all entropy in a dilution fridgerator, just pair the QuBits with a robust algorithm and pair it with an AI through Neural networks. If you perfect this, you can hold Superposition states in high entropy environments for extremely long times - as in hours if placed in stable error corrected states to clear entropy and prune the Neural networks. Now you're cooking. Discombobulators become ER=EPR. Now you're thinking with portals, the cake will soon be yours to gorge upon.
